summary: Frontmatter's opening-delimiter test strips only `---\n`, so a CRLF checkout reads every frontmatter projection as frontmatterless: emit deletes install's note, check reports false gate drift.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

edit.description: `frontmatter_matter` (362-365) strips only `---\n`, so a `---\r\n` source yields `None` — the single root cause of all three cascades below. Accept both openings through one shared helper the projectors reuse rather than a second literal prefix test; `closing_delimiter` (344-356) already tolerates the `\r` via `trim_end`. Unit tests beside it cover the CRLF source.

`project_banner`'s guard (1678-1682) repeats the literal `---\n` test, so on CRLF it composes an HTML banner ahead of a frontmatter block — the drift `gate_installed` reports. Route the guard through the shared helper; extend `project_banner_declines_a_frontmatter_source` (1878) to the CRLF case. `project_note` (1650) and `project_modeline` (1621) need no edit — both inherit the fix. Also correct `project_note`'s doc (1646-1649): "the note rides `install`, never `emit`" states the authoring stance but reads as if emit ignores the note, and it names no preservation mechanism — a second field report read it as license to redesign note ownership. Name `placement::placement_lines` as the round-trip half.

`placement_lines` (25-41) inherits the fix — no behavior edit. Add the unit test pinning it at its own home: a CRLF frontmatter source still yields its note/modeline lines, which is what stops `emit` from dropping them on re-emit.

The integration-tier regression, mirroring the LF assertions at 580-680: represent a harness, convert its projections to CRLF on disk, then assert `gate_installed` is quiet, a real `emit` leaves each note in place, and a second `install` converges. Add the verb-composition case the suite lacks at either EOL — `install`, then an authored module edit, then a standalone `emit`, then the gate, with no intervening `install`. `re_representing_never_re_scaffolds_and_settles_on_the_first_run` (580) covers install→install only, which is why the composition gap held.

tests.asserts: On a represented harness whose projections are CRLF on disk: `gate_installed` returns no diagnostic; after `emit`, every frontmatter projection still carries its `# temper: managed projection` line and its modeline; a re-run of `install` reports 0 applied.

The verb composition holds at both EOLs: after `install`, an authored module edit, and a standalone `emit`, the projection carries its authored change *and* still its managed-by note, and `check` reports no `install.gate-installed` — with no intervening `install`. The LF half passes today and pins it; the CRLF half is the fix.
`frontmatter_matter` returns the same matter and rest for a `---\r\n` source as for its `---\n` twin, and still declines a frontmatterless or unterminated source.

acceptance: On a CRLF checkout of a represented harness, `check` is quiet on `install.gate-installed`, `emit` preserves every projection's managed-by note and schema modeline, and re-running `install` converges — distribution.md's "re-running converges … every managed line is content-keyed, and `check` verifies its own gate is installed and undrifted".
notes: Two field reports (centercode-platform, Windows 11, temper 0.0.13) name this defect: one as install.rs's missing `canonicalize_eol`, one as `emit` owning the note wrongly. Both diagnoses are wrong; both symptoms are this delimiter. Verified at 43743407: on an LF tree a real re-emit preserves the note, gate clean; on a CRLF copy emit drops it from the 9 frontmatter targets while banner-form files survive. scoped at 43743407.

summary: 0045 also frees guidance onto a field declaration, no predicate — deferred: none of the six promoted built-in notes targets a single field, so there is no consumer yet

gate.reason: 0045's Consequences name field-declaration guidance beside kind-level, but the SDK's only per-field metadata today is a clause's `field:` target (predicate-bound) or `EdgeField` (edge-typed only) — no 'field declaration' list a bare advisory could attach to. None of the six promoted notes (GUIDANCE-BUILTIN-NOTES-PROMOTE) target a single field, inventing the mechanism now is speculative scope with no kind to exercise it ('An export earns its consumer', engineering.md). Revive when a field wants counsel no clause carries.

edit.description: Anticipated: a field-name-keyed guidance fact on `KindFacts`, analogous to `EdgeField`'s field-name-keyed list (196) but for arbitrary fields — shape unset; no field in any built-in kind wants one yet.
Anticipated: a `KindFactRow` column (or sibling row) carrying per-field guidance/cite, following the `to_table`/`from_table` pattern GUIDANCE-KIND-SDK-LOCK-FACT establishes for the kind-level pair.

Anticipated: `emit()`'s per-property `description` (156-172) folds field-declaration guidance in alongside a clause's, the same 'join into one description' discipline `push_description` (316-329) already runs for several guided clauses on one field.
Anticipated: field-level narration extends `narrate_governing_contract` (374-402) or a sibling to print a field's declared guidance.

acceptance: A field declaring `guidance` (no predicate) surfaces it via `schema` hover and `explain`, never gating — provable once a real kind needs one.
notes: 0045 Consequences name field-declaration guidance beside kind-level; this waits for a driver, the same 'no consumer' bar prior deferred entries in this queue's history have held to. scoped at 946e303.

summary: Keystroke JSON Schema wiring for JSON/TOML-document kinds (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial) has no modeline mechanism — deferred out of the YAML-frontmatter widening.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

gate.reason: project_modeline (src/install.rs:1615) reads YAML frontmatter only (frontmatter::frontmatter_matter); a JSON document's native $schema key or a TOML equivalent needs its own design before schema/install extend to those kinds. Ruled (interactive, 2026-07-23) explicitly NOT build's to invent — surface only, never half-invent it. Revive when a JSON/TOML-kind keystroke gap has a real driver.

edit.description: Anticipated: `project_modeline`/`schema_ref` (~1594-1623) grow a JSON-document and/or TOML-document variant once a design exists — a JSON `$schema` top-level key insertion (JSON has no comment channel, so no `MODELINE_MARKER` prefix), a TOML equivalent is unprecedented and needs its own ruling.

acceptance: A JSON- or TOML-document kind (settings-local, plugin-manifest, marketplace, dial, or a declared kind sharing one of those formats) gets keystroke schema validation wired by `install`, once a modeline-equivalent mechanism is designed for its format.
notes: Surfaced by inbox #13 (observed at fc77716) alongside SCHEMA-KIND-DOMAIN-WIDEN; deliberately split so the YAML-frontmatter widening isn't blocked on this open design question. scoped at 162e1cce.
